display.purpose: Hero headline only — Iowan Old Style serif. One per page.

headline.purpose: Spoken italic tagline under the hero — Avenir Next italic.

title.purpose: Serif titles on panels/toasts — small serif, not display.

body.purpose: All working copy, captions, status. System sans, 65–75ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked humanist-sans badges only. Never section eyebrows.

shadows.name: ambient-float
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for cards, dropzone, nav.

shadows.name: ambient-lift
shadows.purpose: Deepest lift for drag-active and modal-like moments (--shadow-soft).

shadows.name: inset-highlight
shadows.purpose: Top-edge catch-light that sells the warm-glass material.

shadows.name: accent-halo
shadows.purpose: Soft Ember ring on drag-accept and focus.

motion.name: ease-warm
motion.purpose: Standard ease-out for surfaces, menus, buttons, and lifts.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: State feedback on controls (hover, focus, active).

motion.name: duration-surface
motion.purpose: Glass surface transitions (nav scroll, dropzone hover).

motion.name: shimmer
motion.purpose: Ember progress shimmer while a job processes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action — Start reconstruction. Ink-on-sand inversion, full pill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 30px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--fg, #2b2419); color: var(--bg, #ece5d9); font: 750 16px/-apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; box-shadow: 0 18px 46px color-mix(in oklch, var(--fg, #2b2419) 18%, transparent); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), filter 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: scale(1.02); filter: brightness(1.04); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b8622f); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis outline pill — the GitHub Star link. Border shifts to Ember on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 13px 0 15px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--border, #cdc4b5) 70%, transparent); border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--surface, #f8f4ee) 36%, transparent); color: var(--fg, #2b2419); font: 400 14px/1 Optima, 'Avenir Next', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, background 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent, #b8622f) 55%, var(--border, #cdc4b5)); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--surface, #f8f4ee) 70%, transparent); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b8622f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Format Badge
components.description: Read-only spec/format tag — uppercase tracked label. Not interactive.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--border, #cdc4b5) 80%, transparent); border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--surface, #f8f4ee) 64%, transparent); color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--fg, #2b2419) 78%, var(--muted, #6b6357)); font: 500 11px/1.4 Optima, 'Avenir Next', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; }

components.css: .ds-dropzone { display: grid; gap: 18px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--border, #cdc4b5) 92%, transparent); border-radius: 24px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--surface, #f8f4ee) 80%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 18px 52px rgb(82 58 30 / 0.13), inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.44); backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(1.1); transition: border-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease, transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-dropzone:hover { border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent, #b8622f) 32%, var(--border, #cdc4b5)); } .ds-dz-head { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 18px; } .ds-dz-title { font: 500 19px/1.12 'Iowan Old Style', Charter, Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -0.006em; color: var(--fg, #2b2419); } .ds-dz-well { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 15px; min-height: 116px; padding: 23px 24px; border: 1px dashed color-mix(in oklch, var(--border, #cdc4b5) 76%, var(--fg, #2b2419) 10%); border-radius: 17px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--bg, #ece5d9) 48%, transparent); transition: border-color 180ms ease, background 180ms ease; } .ds-dropzone:hover .ds-dz-well { border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent, #b8622f) 56%, var(--border, #cdc4b5)); } .ds-dz-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; flex: 0 0 auto; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--border, #cdc4b5) 70%, transparent); border-radius: 13px; color: var(--fg, #2b2419); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--surface, #f8f4ee) 76%, var(--accent, #b8622f) 8%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.22); } .ds-dz-copy { display: grid; gap: 3px; } .ds-dz-copy strong { font: 500 15.5px/1.3 -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--fg, #2b2419); } .ds-dz-copy span { font: 400 13.5px/1.4 -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--muted, #6b6357); }

components.css: .ds-queue-row { display: grid; gap: 4px; padding: 14px 18px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--border, #cdc4b5) 88%, transparent); border-radius: 18px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--surface, #f8f4ee) 80%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 18px 54px rgb(82 58 30 / 0.13); backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(1.12); } .ds-qr-top { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 14px; } .ds-qr-name { overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; font: 650 14px/1.3 -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--fg, #2b2419); } .ds-qr-status { font: 650 13px/1 -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--muted, #6b6357); } .ds-qr-meta { font: 400 13px/1.4 -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--muted, #6b6357); } .ds-qr-track { position: relative; overflow: hidden; height: 3px; border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--border, #cdc4b5) 70%, transparent); } .ds-qr-fill { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: 42%; border-radius: inherit; background: linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent, #b8622f) 62%, transparent), var(--accent, #b8622f)); animation: ds-shimmer 1.15s linear infinite; } @keyframes ds-shimmer { from { transform: translateX(-40%); } to { transform: translateX(140%); } }

narrative.overview: A hi-fi mastering room at golden hour. Warm lamplight falls on sand-toned walls; brass-warm accents catch the eye; a few floating glass panels glow as if lit from within. The interface is not a lab, not a startup dashboard, and not a cluttered DAW — it is a calm, expert space where a good file gets handed back better. The system is warm-neutral by default and spends its one saturated color — Terracotta Ember — sparingly, on the moments that matter. Depth comes from warm glass: backdrop-blurred floating surfaces with a warm ambient shadow beneath and a bright inset highlight along the top edge. Typography pairs a warm literary serif for display and titles against a clean system sans for body and a humanist sans for labels — contrast by axis, never two sans that almost match.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-neutral sand canvas; one saturated accent (Terracotta Ember) used on ≤10% of any screen.
Signature warm-glass elevation: backdrop-blur + warm ambient shadow + inset top-highlight.
Serif-display / system-sans / humanist-label three-voice type system.
Generous pill geometry (999px) on all interactive controls.
Light and dark themes, both warm-tinted; identical component grammar across them.
Motion is calm and honest: state feedback, not choreography.

rules.name: The One Ember Rule
rules.body: Terracotta Ember covers ≤10% of any screen. Its rarity is what makes the primary action and the active state read instantly. If two things on screen are ember, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Legible Muted Rule
rules.body: --muted on --bg/--surface is the single most likely contrast failure. Body and status text must clear 4.5:1; placeholder and tertiary captions are held to the same bar, not excused as elegant. When in doubt, push the text toward Ink, never toward the sand.

rules.name: The Serif-Speaks Rule
rules.body: The serif is for identity and headings — display, titles, the wordmark, the drag overlay. It never sets body copy, form controls, or data. Those are sans, always.

rules.name: The Quiet Kicker Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked labels are permitted only as file-format badges where the letterform-as-spec reading is the point. They are forbidden as section eyebrows above headings.

rules.name: The Warm-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are warm brown (rgb(82 58 30)), never neutral black in the light theme. A cool black shadow instantly breaks the golden-hour room.

rules.name: The Floating-Glass Rule
rules.body: Glass (backdrop-blur) is for surfaces that float over content: nav, dropzone, cards, toast, menu. It is forbidden as decoration on inline or full-width blocks. If a surface doesn't float, it doesn't blur.

dos: Do spend Terracotta Ember on ≤10% of the screen — primary action, focus, progress, and glow only.
Do keep body and status text at ≥4.5:1 against sand/surface in both themes; push toward Ink, never toward sand.
Do use warm-brown ambient shadows (rgb(82 58 30 / …)) with a white inset top-highlight on every glass surface.
Do set the serif (Iowan Old Style) for display, titles, and the wordmark; system sans for body; humanist sans for labels/controls.
Do make every interactive control a full pill (999px) and give it default/hover/focus-visible/disabled states.
Do surface the machine honestly — waking, processing, retrying, done, error — with aria-live and calm motion.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: the mesh blobs, shimmer, and card entrance must have an instant/calm fallback.
donts: Don't build a generic SaaS template — no dark hero gradients, no hero-metric stat blocks, no identical feature-card grids, no tiny uppercase tracked eyebrows above sections.
Don't build a cluttered audio-tool UI — no knobs, meters, waveform scrubbers, or toolbar overload. One task, one surface.
Don't use --muted gray for anything that must be read comfortably; if it looks elegant and faint, it's failing contrast.
Don't apply glassmorphism to inline or full-width blocks. Glass is for floating surfaces only.
Don't use neutral black shadows in the light theme — they break the golden-hour warmth.
Don't pair the system sans with another near-identical sans, or set body copy in the serif.
Don't push the display headline past its 116px ceiling or tighten letter-spacing below -0.04em.
Don't use a conventional green for success — success is Warm Amber.
Don't add numbered section markers (01/02/03) or eyebrow kickers as scaffolding.
